hub.title: Stock
hub.subtitle: Items, levels and movements
hub.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or barcode
hub.emptyFirst: Add your first item to start tracking stock.

form.name: Name
form.hsnHint: Required on GST invoices above the turnover threshold.
form.trackStockHint: Sales and purchases will move this item
form.activeHint: Inactive items are hidden when creating documents.
form.trackStockHintFull: Sales and purchases will move this item's stock automatically.
form.serviceUnitHint: Services are always billed in Nos.
form.openingStockDateHint: The day this stock was counted. No invoice or bill with this item can be dated before it.
form.skuTaken: Another item already uses this SKU
form.openingLocked: Use a stock adjustment to change this.

supplyHint.nil: Taxed at 0% by the schedule, such as fresh vegetables or salt.
supplyHint.exempt: Exempt by notification, such as healthcare or education services.
supplyHint.nonGst: Outside GST altogether, such as petrol or alcohol for drinking.

gst.reimbursementHint: You pay this for the customer and recover exactly what you paid (pure agent, Rule 33). No GST, and it stays out of the taxable value.
gst.reverseChargeHint: A notified supply where the buyer pays the GST, such as transport by a GTA or legal services.
gst.cessHint: Compensation cess on top of GST, for goods like tobacco, aerated drinks and cars. Leave blank if none.
gst.capitalGoodsHint: Machinery or equipment you keep and use. Its input tax credit is reported separately.
gst.itcHint: Whether the GST you pay when buying this can be claimed back.

itcOptionHint.eligible: Used in the business: the GST paid is credit.
itcOptionHint.blocked: Food, personal vehicles, club fees, works contracts for buildings and the like.
itcOptionHint.ineligible: Used for exempt supplies or personal purposes.

detail.deleteMessage: Documents that already use this item keep their own copy of the details. This cannot be undone.

transfer.oneLocationBody: Add a second branch under Settings to move stock between locations.
transfer.onlyAvailable: Only {{qty}} {{unit}} available at the source branch
transfer.twoMovesNote: Transfers post two movements — one out of the source branch and one into the destination — so total stock stays unchanged.

adjust.negativeWarning: This would take stock negative. Check the quantity before saving.

scan.noItemBody: Add the barcode to an existing item, or create a new one.
scan.pointCamera: Point the camera at a barcode
scan.manualNote: Camera scanning is not available yet. Type or paste the code from the label, or pick an item below.

lowStock.allStockedBody: No item is at or below its reorder level.

opening.intro: Enter what you already had on hand when you started using the app. This posts an opening movement and does not affect your sales or purchase figures.

movements.noneBody: Stock movements appear as you buy, sell and adjust.

ocr.nothingScannedBody: Capture a bill first and the extracted fields will appear here.
ocr.saveNote: Saving opens a pre-filled form — nothing is written to your books until you finish it yourself.
ocr.cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable here. Choose a photo instead.
ocr.howItWorksBody: Nothing is saved until you confirm it. Low-confidence fields are flagged so you can correct them first.
ocr.ocrUnavailable: Bill scanning works in the installed Elixir Books app on Android or iPhone. It is not available in the browser or in Expo Go.
ocr.noTextFound: No text found. Retake the photo flat and in good light.
ocr.cameraDenied: Allow camera access in Settings to scan a bill.
ocr.galleryDenied: Allow photo access in Settings to pick a bill.

catalog.search: Search by name, SKU or HSN
catalog.noServicesBody: Add the work you charge for, like installation or maintenance, to put it on invoices in a tap.
catalog.noItemsBody: Add what you sell to put it on invoices in a tap.
